You are the **BUILDER** for six targeted pre-PR fixes. Six commits of SFCC-89 have landed; three independent audits (design fidelity, local-docs conformance, PR #59 conformance) then found these. All are small and precise.

Repo: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa` @ `3920caf`. **Working tree completely clean.** Keep it that way except for the files below.

---

# FIX 1 — Route the style-code label through react-intl

`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx:9` — `const LABEL = 'Style Code:';`

An earlier commit removed `useUiCopy` from this label. The **diagnosis was right** (`useContentful.ts` sends no `locale`, so a CMS lookup serves one space default to all eight storefronts) but the **remedy inverted an explicit instruction**: the takeover report for the superseded PR named this exact string among four to route through `react-intl`, and states *"a hardcoded English literal is the same class of defect as a hardcoded hex."* Eleven locales are configured.

**Use `useIntl().formatMessage` with an inline `defaultMessage`** — the repo's existing pattern, see `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:409,435,459`. That needs **no** edit to `translations/` (Tier 2 — do not touch it). Pick an id consistent with how the repo names them; check existing ids first.

**`components.md:72` explicitly exempts `useIntl`** from the container/presentational rule for exactly this case.

**⚠️ Gate consequence you must handle:** `useIntl()` **throws** without an `IntlProvider` (`components.md:85`). The atom's existing test uses a bare `render()` and **will throw**. Wrap it. Storybook is fine — `.storybook/preview.tsx` supplies a provider.

**Also restore a mechanical check that the label is sourced.** The commit that hardcoded it deleted the only test proving that, in the same change. A test asserting `formatMessage` is what produces the label (e.g. rendering under a provider with a non-English locale/messages override and asserting the translated string) closes it. Declare the test-count delta.

# FIX 2 — Move `textStyle` from the JSX element into the recipe, all five components

Currently on the element in all five; `.css.ts` recipes hold none:

| Component | current |
|---|---|
| `zimmProductName/index.tsx:31` | `textStyle="heading3"` |
| `zimmProductPrice/index.tsx:59` | `textStyle="price"` |
| `zimmProductDescription/index.tsx:25` | `textStyle="body2"` |
| `zimmProductModelInfo/index.tsx:33` | `textStyle="caption"` |
| `zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx:32` | `textStyle="caption"` |

**Three independent reasons, all verified:**

1. **`recipeGuards.test.ts:149` recommends exactly this** — *"Set type with `textStyle` (all 22 Handover styles ARE registered)"*. So the recipe is the documented home, not merely #59's habit.
2. **#59 does it 15 times and zero times as a JSX prop** — e.g. `footer/footerNavColumn/footerNavColumn.css.ts:45 textStyle: 'navigation'`.
3. **A style prop silently overwrites the recipe.** Verified in `@chakra-ui/system/dist/index.js:207-213`: `assignAfter({}, __css, finalBaseStyle, filterUndefined(styleProps), sx)` — `styleProps` come *after* `__css`. So `zimmProductPrice.css.ts:12`'s claim that SFCC-194 can add a `sale` variant with *"nothing else in this file needs to change"* is **false today** for any variant touching the type scale; the variant's values land in `__css` and get overwritten. Moving `textStyle` into the recipe makes that comment true.

Also: `zimmProductName.css.ts:9-13` explains `color` was moved off a JSX prop *specifically so `recipeGuards` could see it*. Type was left where the guard is blind. **Fix the inconsistency, and if any recipe comment now misstates where type lives, correct it.**

For the multipart `zimmProductStyleCode`, put it on the part that currently carries it (the root).

**Rendered output must be identical.** Prove it — don't assert it.

# FIX 3 — `recipeParts.test.ts` carries a false cross-reference

`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts:15-16`:
> *"Scope: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/**`. Recipes elsewhere are covered by `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`."*

**False.** `recipeGuards.test.ts` has **no** parts-vs-reads check — its only `parts` mentions are a spacing-token splitter at `:321-322` and a namespacing comment at `:350`. So `footer/footer.css.ts`, `footer/footerNavColumn/footerNavColumn.css.ts` and `footer/bottomBar/bottomBar.css.ts` are unguarded, and the comment says they aren't.

**Preferred fix: widen the walk root to `overrides/app/components` so those three are genuinely covered, and correct the docstring.** All three declare `parts:`, so expect **+3 test cases**.

**If widening makes the gate fail** — because a footer recipe declares a part its component never reads — **do not force it.** That is a real finding about #59's code, not yours to fix here. Revert to correcting the docstring only (state plainly that recipes outside `ui-kits/` are *not* covered), and **report the failing recipe and part**. Either outcome is acceptable; say which you took and why.

The auditor also noted `READ_RE` only recognises the identifier `styles`, so `zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:37,97`'s `chrome.actions` is invisible. Broaden it **only if** you are already widening and it does not destabilise the gate.

# FIX 4 — `ZimmProductName` renders unconditionally

`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductName/index.tsx:30-34` has no guard. `ZimmProductPrice` and `ZimmProductMeta` both guard inside the atom; this one relies on `productInfo.ts:54`'s `if (!product?.name) return null` — a page-level selector, i.e. the call site.

The local docs are explicit: *"An empty-string fallback is a layout bug — it renders an empty element that keeps its margins. **Fix at the atom**, not at each call site."*

`name: string` is required so TypeScript covers *absent*, but an empty string still renders an empty `heading3` node that takes a flex gap in `ZimmProductContent`'s column.

**Add the guard after the hook** — before it, and `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` errors (this is why the sibling atoms do it that way; match their form and their comment). `zimmProductName/index.test.tsx` **exists** — assert the new branch there.

# FIX 5 — one line

`overrides/app/theme/index.test.tsx`'s `component overrides are registered` test pins `ZimmProductMeta`, `ZimmProductName`, `ZimmProductModelInfo`. **Add `ZimmProductPrice`.** It currently has no registration pin, no `.css.test.ts`, no `play`, and its test asserts only text and ARIA — so unregistering it is invisible at every layer. Add it to the **existing** test (no new test).

# FIX 6 — one story

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.stories.tsx` never exercises `isProductPartOfBundle: true` — it's `false` at `:65`/`:95` and omitted at `:114`. So the two branches whose in-file comments justify their existence (`:88-90`, the price gate) have **zero** mechanical coverage.

**Add a fourth story with `isProductPartOfBundle: true`**, asserting the price is absent and the promo callout is absent. Expect **G4 105 → 106**.

---

# Gates — declare your deltas up front, then reconcile term by term

| Gate | Baseline | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| G1 `npx tsc --noEmit` | 0 | **0** |
| G2 `npx vitest run` | **364 / 24** | **364 + F1 + F3 + F4 / 24** — declare each term. F3 is +3 if widening holds, +0 if you revert to comment-only. Files stay 24 unless you add a test file, which you should not need. |
| G3 `npm run lint` | 17 err / 15 warn | **17 / 15** |
| G4 storybook | 105 / 24 | **106 / 24** — **REBUILD REQUIRED.** `a11y: { test: 'error' }` so all are axe assertions |
| G5 `npm run audit:tokens` | 14 unack / 22 ack | **14 / 22** — add no literals |

Read counts, not exit codes: G3 and G5 both exit 1 at a healthy baseline. `test-storybook`'s default URL is free now, but still bind port 0, serve `storybook-static` with `python3 -m http.server`, and pass `--url`.

# Do NOT

- Touch `translations/` (Tier 2), `theme/foundation/`, test config, `package.json`, or `scripts/`.
- Commit, stage, stash, or touch any git ref.
- Append args to `npm run lint`. `lint:fix` / `pwa-kit-dev format` forbidden.
- Run `npm start`. Install packages.
- Change any design *value* — colours, spacing, type scales all stay. Fix 2 relocates where `textStyle` is declared, nothing more.
- Fix anything outside these six. Report it instead.

Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`.

# Standing rules — every one earned in this sequence

- **Locate by content; report `brief says :N, found at :M`.** Every number here has drifted at least once.
- **Mutation-prove every new or changed assertion** — flip it, watch it fail, restore. Prove `tsc` checks a file with an **undeclared identifier**, never a bad Chakra token (a typo'd responsive key type-checks clean).
- **Name mutation backups by full-path slug, never `basename`** — a collision destroyed a file earlier in this run.
- **Every claim in a comment must be true of observable state.** Fix 3 exists because that was violated; four such comments have been found across this work, two of them claims I supplied.
- **Instruction refusal authorised** — report `REFUSED: <instruction> — <why> — <what I did instead>`. Fired three times, correct every time.
- **Treat every claim in this brief as CLAIMED.** Twelve of my assertions have been caught wrong in this run.

# Report back

1. Declared deltas, then reconciled term by term.
2. Each fix: final `file:line`, and the re-location table.
3. **Fix 2: your proof the rendered output is unchanged.**
4. **Fix 3: which option you took, and if you widened, whether the three footer recipes passed.**
5. Your mutation proof for every new/changed assertion.
6. The five gate numbers, G3 warnings and G5 acknowledged explicit, plus confirmation you rebuilt Storybook on a port from binding 0.
7. `git diff --stat` + `git status --short`.
8. Anything noticed, not fixed. Any `REFUSED:`.
